descriptor: Independent magazine of culture, science and food

voice.summary: Reads like a well-edited magazine standfirst: confident, a little wry, always specific. Headlines promise one clear idea and the dek delivers a surprise.
dos: Write headlines as a concrete claim or image
Give reading time and author honestly
Prefer a vivid noun to an adjective
donts: No clickbait or numbered listicle titles

taglines: Read by lamplight, think by morning
Culture, science and supper, in depth
boilerplate: The Lamplight Review is an independent magazine publishing long-form stories on culture, science, food and travel for readers who like to take their time.
